title: Opening hours
description:
Work out whether a shop is open, across time zones, with `java.time`.

```
Shop (Europe/London) at 2026-11-20T17:30Z: open, closes in 30 minutes
Shop at 2026-11-21T09:00 New York time: open (it is 14:00 in London)
Next opening after Saturday 18:00: Monday 09:00
```
hints: `LocalDateTime local = when.withZoneSameInstant(SHOP).toLocalDateTime();` then compare `local.toLocalTime()` with the day's hours (lesson 7.04).
For the next opening, try each day from `after.toLocalDate()` for 8 days, and return the first opening time that is after `after`.
requirements: Opening hours per `DayOfWeek`: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00, Saturday 10:00 to 16:00, Sunday closed.
`isOpen(ZonedDateTime when)` converts to the shop's zone with `withZoneSameInstant`.
`nextOpening(LocalDateTime after)` finds the next opening time, at most a week ahead.
stretch: Add holidays (a `Set<LocalDate>`) when the shop is closed all day.
